channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Situational Awareness hedge fund meltdown was a warning shot for leveraged markets, BofA CEO says
item.description: Bank of America was among the prime brokers for the hedge fund, which is run by Leopold Aschenbrenner.

item.title: Trump admin refunds $100 billion in 'liberation day' tariffs
item.description: The Trump administration has taken steps to effectively re-create the IEEPA tariff regime using other legal authorities. They already face court challenges.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary as voters pivot to the left
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, setting up a context with former Rep. Mike Rogers in the November general election.

item.title: Dow rallies 450 points and hits fresh record on earnings strength, hope around U.S.-Iran deal: Live updates
item.description: The S&P 500 rose to a new all-time intraday record on Wednesday, building on its big rally in recent days.

item.title: SpaceX moon crash is a perfect metaphor for rocket maker’s share price, analysts say
item.description: Parts of a SpaceX rocket reportedly crashed into the Moon on Wednesday

item.title: Chipmaker Broadcom is breaking out. How Tony Zhang is trading it
item.description: Broadcom is growing AI semiconductor revenue at triple-digit rates, converting nearly half of revenue into free cash flow, writes Tony Zhang.

item.title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
item.description: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says 'now is the time to start slowly moving' rates up
item.description: Kashkari was one of three dissenters at last week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

item.title: Disney weighs free, ad-supported streaming, says it has sold out Super Bowl ad spots
item.description: Disney is considering a free streaming product as advertising takes a bigger role in making streaming profitable.

item.title: SpaceX stock falls 7% after AI spending surge rattles investors
item.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

item.title: Saudi wealth fund and Jared Kushner's Affinity finalize $55 billion EA Sports deal
item.description: EA said its stock has ceased trading and will be delisted from the Nasdaq. Its shareholders will receive $210 in cash per share.

item.title: Anthropic's Mythos created fake identities to fool humans in new cyber incident
item.description: It's the latest cybersecurity incident involving frontier models developed by Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: Private companies added just 44,000 workers in July, below expectations, ADP reports
item.description: Hiring at private companies slowed considerably in July, with most of the job growth coming health care.

item.title: Lucid stock plunges as EV maker begins 'operational reset,' delays midsize vehicle
item.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

item.title: The IRS is getting better at spotting crypto tax mistakes. Here's what it means for investors
item.description: Many investors who hold cryptocurrency like bitcoin and ether have a difficult time figuring out how much tax to pay on transactions.

item.title: The Nasdaq just did something it's done just 17 prior times in its history
item.description: Tuesday’s rally was historic for several reasons.

item.title: Uber issues weaker-than-expected bookings, earnings forecasts for third quarter
item.description: Uber's earnings were in line with estimates, but the company's guidance for the third quarter trailed expectations.

item.title: Lisa Su brushes off Musk's Nvidia commitment as AMD stock sinks after earnings
item.description: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.

item.title: Warren presses Lutnick over UAE access to sensitive U.S. tech after Trump crypto investment
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Howard Lutnick to explain eased UAE export controls after UAE-linked entities invested in the Trump family’s crypto venture.

item.title: Oil prices fall on negotiations to manage ship traffic in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Crude prices rose Wednesday after Yemen's Houthis claimed they had struck a Saudi Arabian oil tanker in the Red Sea.

item.title: We're pocketing gains in two tech stocks that are hitting new record highs
item.description: Even though the fundamentals look more promising, we want to be disciplined about rallies in the stocks and take profits along the way.

item.title: More than half of Americans come up as much as $250 short each month — here's how to find that money
item.description: If you're coming up $250 short each month, these simple moves could help you close the gap.

item.title: Disney tops earnings estimates as parks and streaming offer a boost
item.description: Disney reported growth at its domestic theme parks and cruises despite mounting macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers.

item.title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
item.description: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from previous guidance of $82 billion to $85 billion.

item.title: CVS blows past estimates, hikes guidance as insurance unit continues to improve
item.description: CVS also announced a new collaboration with Eli Lilly that will make Zepbound and Foundayo accessible to eligible patients on the CVS Health app.

item.title: Mortgage rates hit their highest level in over a year, causing demand to drop below year-ago levels
item.description: Mortgage rates rose to the highest level in over a year, causing total mortgage demand to drop below year-ago levels.

item.title: Stock bears obliterated as Nasdaq 100 logs top 10 bullish stat of past decade
item.description: "Pessimists threw in the towel and optimism was running amok today," said Nations Indexes president Scott Nations.

item.title: Circle names BlackRock, Visa and others as initial Arc partners, signaling early institutional backing
item.description: Circle on Wednesday revealed the initial group of partners that will help run the company's new Arc blockchain.

item.title: GM, Chinese automaker extend joint venture for 20 years despite geopolitical tensions with U.S.
item.description: GM said the deal will focus on domestic sales of Buick and Cadillac models in China and exporting Chevrolet products built in China for non-U.S. markets.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Wednesday
item.description: AMD and SpaceX are pulling back after earnings. But Eli Lilly is jumping after crushing estimates.
